column1: # Every OrFS assertion that is EXPECTED to fail and is NOT explained by the
# mechanical rule "the test creates a FIFO/block/char/socket node, which OrFS
# rejects with EOPNOTSUPP" must appear here, keyed by (file, assertion number)
# of the pinned pjdfstest suite (Dockerfile.posix, PJDFSTEST_COMMIT).
# scripts/posix/pjdfstest.sh classifies failures mechanically, then resolves any
# remaining failure through this map. The gate fails if:
#   * a failing assertion is neither mechanical nor listed here (a regression), or
#   * a listed assertion no longer fails (drift: fix it and delete the entry).
# Phase 25 closed every real OrFS deviation the Phase 24 court found (implicit
# timestamps, setuid/setgid on write/truncate, utimensat(UTIME_NOW) with write
# permission, ftruncate through a writable fd, and non-root supplementary-group
# chgrp). The sole remaining entry is an artifact the reference ext4 fails too.

column4: the reference (ext4) fails this assertion too; not an OrFS deviation
